**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/09/14 (Thu) 06:11
- [FACT] User inquired about GenICam.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] GenICam is an open standard for generic machine vision software and hardware interface.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] GenICam defines a common interface for machine vision cameras and imaging systems.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] GenICam provides a uniform way to access and control the features of machine vision cameras and imaging systems.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] GenICam makes it easier for software developers to write camera-agnostic applications.
